caption: The drawing features a rectangular section divided into three main horizontal bands, centered on a plain light beige background. The top band consists of an ornamental pattern with repeating geometric and arch-like shapes in shades of brown, beige, and cream, with dark lines accentuating the details. Below the ornamental band, there is a narrow beige strip separating it from a wide solid blue horizontal band in the center, which occupies the majority of the composition. At the bottom, another narrow band consists of a pattern in alternating beige and brown with diagonal lines and rectangular shapes, with a thin blue line separating it from the central blue section. The objects and patterns are precisely bordered and the composition is symmetrical along the horizontal axis.
title: Wallpaper Border
